stem: Why should drying, curing, packaging and storage be treated as controlled post-harvest processes rather than simply waiting for time to pass?
choices: Environmental and storage conditions can influence quality and chemical stability after harvest
Post-harvest conditions cannot affect harvested plant material
Only the cultivar name determines all post-harvest outcomes
Packaging choice is unrelated to storage conditions
rationale: Post-harvest environmental and storage conditions influence quality and stability, making process control important after harvest.
